title: MOSAIC: Unveiling the Moral, Social and Individual Dimensions of Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.00048v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in sensitive applications including psychological support, healthcare, and high-stakes decision-making. This expansion has motivated growing research into the ethical and moral foundations underlying LLM behavior, raising critical questions about their reliability in ethical reasoning. translated_title: MOSAIC：揭示大型语言模型的道德、社会与个体维度
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地部署在敏感应用中，包括心理支持、医疗保健和高风险决策。这种扩展推动了关于LLM行为背后伦理和道德基础的研究日益增多，引发了对它们在伦理推理中可靠性的关键质疑。然而，现有研究和基准几乎完全依赖道德基础理论（MFT），在很大程度上忽视了其他相关维度，如塑造人类伦理推理的社会价值观、人格特质和个体特征。为解决这些局限性，我们引入了MOSAIC，这是首个旨在联合评估LLM道德、社会和个体特征的大规模基准。该基准包含九个源自道德哲学、心理学和社会理论的验证问卷，以及四个旨在探究道德的平台游戏。
tldr: MOSAIC是首个联合评估大型语言模型道德、社会和个体维度的综合基准，弥补了现有研究仅依赖道德基础理论的不足。
en_tdlr: MOSAIC is the first comprehensive benchmark jointly evaluating the moral, social, and individual dimensions of large language models, addressing the limitation of existing research relying solely on Moral Foundation Theory.
